input.title: 2026 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360
input.descriptionHtml:
ONE LEFT!!!

Financing Available!*

Book a FREE On-Water Demo!
 

Check out the Pro Angler 14 360 XR - NEW FOR 2024!


Everything elite anglers are looking for in a fishing kayak total control, power, stability, performance, stealth, comfort and feature-rich. Its wide, rock-solid standing platform comes decked out with noise-reducing EVA traction pads. With the MirageDrive 360 propulsion system, Hobie is taking pedal kayaking in every direction. Literally. New 360 Drive Technology allows anglers to move in every degree on the compass. Explore wherever you want to go with the all-new Kick-Up fins that automatically retract upon impact. This Pro Angler packs extreme fishing utility, with scads of (that's six) horizontal rod holders, enough tackle compartments to empty a store, and an elevated Vantage ST seat that's as much easy chair as captain's perch. There's a non-skid deck for standing - a huge advantage for sight fishing - and veritable acres of H-Rail for mounting rod holders and electronics. All this on a spacious 14-foot platform, with no need for a gas tank.

Length: 13' 8" / 4.17 m
Width: 38" / .97 m
Hull Weight: 124.5 LBS / 56.5 KG
Fully Rigged Weight: 148.5 LBS / 67.4 KG
Capacity: 600 lbs / 272 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity: 350 lbs / 159 kg
Crew: 1
 


 
*Must be approved by Synchrony Financial with a large enough credit line to cover the purchase price. Call (815) 433-2200 for more info
